job.title: AI Proof of Concept Project with Davinci Model
job.description:
CUSTOMER wishes to use AI to generate summary analysis (reports) of IT vendor contract proposals ("deals"). To generate these reports, we would train an AI model using existing reports created by CUSTOMER analysts on similar deals by the same vendors.
 
For example, CUSTOMER sees dozens of deals every year from the IT vendor, Salesforce. Currently, CUSTOMER analysts benchmark these Salesforce deals against Salesforce deals we have seen previously. Given CUSTOMER's expertise with Salesforce, the analyst will then create a multipage report, called a "Fair Market Value" (FMV) report, that provides guidance to the CUSTOMER client on the potential to improve (or "optimize") a given deal. The FMV report will typically contain a summary overview of our findings, an assessment of whether or not the deal can be optimized, and findings and recommendations specific to the deal in question. The findings and recommendations might include negotiation strategy, pricing analysis, pricing targets, and concluding remarks.
 
A significant amount of the content for FMV reports are "boiler plate" based upon existing FMV reports on, for example, Salesforce deals. CUSTOMER assumes that AI (ChatGPT or other) has the potential to generate much of the boiler plate FMV content for a given deal, enabling the CUSTOMER analyst to focus on customizing the generated content, tailoring it to the specific deal and client at hand.
 
CUSTOMER is looking for an AI Consulting Company with experience in AI (ChatGPT or other) to help us prove our assumption during a Proof-of-Concept engagement.
 
During the POC, CUSTOMER would provide the following:
• The raw text of multiple (100s of) FMV reports for 3 vendors broken out into distinct, normalized sections. At our discretion, CUSTOMER would disguise the actual names of the clients to maintain the confidentiality agreements that we have with our clients. The AI consultants will let us know how many documents are needed per each of the 3 vendors to complete the proof of concept.
• The AI Consultants will have email, video conferencing, chat, phone, and in-person (if needed) access to CUSTOMER's CTO, the GM of CUSTOMER's digital division, selected CUSTOMER analysts and partners.

The AI Consulting Company will
• Review the provided raw text provided by CUSTOMER and determine what is required in building a model to support our objectives.
• Build a functional model that demonstrates that our objectives can be achieved.
